evidence.observation: The current product contract freezes planned LLM expansion in P196 maintenance mode. Existing Assistant/Guided Setup/XML guide/catalog, validation, correction display, review/diff, and explicit import remain compatibility surfaces; provider/API/agent/prompt/benchmark expansion requires an explicit reopen decision.

The existing call path validates a draft with non-mutating dependency review, builds a read-only import/diff projection, requires explicit Import, creates a unique Pipeline, and persists it before refreshing the UI. The method contains no Preview/Run invocation and no direct layer or route mutation; explicit execution remains a separate command path.
The focused read-only draft review owner contract passed 3/3 cases: active Pipeline lookup/diff projection, persistence and active-selection preservation, and safe null-draft handling.

The current-source WPF Guided Setup target passed at 1600x900 with zero layout/text/internal findings. Its assertions cover valid draft creation, validation gates, stale invalidation after intent changes, invalid/custom channel rejection, no Preview/Run/layer/routing side effects, and explicit import recovery for the exercised synthetic flows.

The current-source review-bundle import target passed at 1600x900 with zero layout/text/internal findings. The reviewed bundle path remained a dry-run and did not extract, copy, save, activate, or run during the target.
The VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build exited 0 with 0 errors and 19 existing nullable warnings in unrelated contracts. OpenVisionReadinessCheck exited 0 with all 13 readiness contracts passed.

The separate wpf_shell_host_recipe_manager_summary precheck returned NG because it searched for the stale AutomationId HostRecipeManagerCommandStrip; the visible ID list contains no such item and the capture size is 0x0. The failure is preserved as a UI-smoke limitation and was not used as LLM behavior evidence.

Dependency/reference files are copied before VisionPipelineStorage.Save and SaveActivePipelineName. Save and active-pointer writes are separate operations, and this path has no transaction journal or Import Undo command. Because import uses a new unique Pipeline, the previous active Pipeline file remains available, but a later persistence failure could leave copied assets or a saved new Pipeline; that risk is outside the frozen maintenance-mode verification scope.

The attached plan permits N/A closure for a deprecated/maintenance-only LLM path. The durable decision keeps the current safety contract, does not add a transaction or Undo surface without explicit product direction, and defines a reopen trigger requiring a transaction owner, asset staging/cleanup, pointer recovery, and deterministic fault-injection evidence.
